# Connecting Dots ERP

> Connecting Dots ERP is a professional training institute offering instructor-led SAP, information technology, data, and human resources courses, with practical learning and career placement support. Training is offered in Pune, Mumbai, Raipur, and online.

This file links to public information only. Course offerings, schedules, fees, and availability may change; use the linked pages or contact the institute for current details. Do not infer details that are not stated on the linked pages.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://connectingdotserp.com/): Overview of the institute and its training programs.
- [Courses](https://connectingdotserp.com/courses): Browse training programs.
- [SAP courses](https://connectingdotserp.com/courses/sap): SAP training programs.
- [IT courses](https://connectingdotserp.com/courses/it): Information technology and software training programs.
- [HR courses](https://connectingdotserp.com/courses/hr): Human resources training programs.
- [About us](https://connectingdotserp.com/aboutus): Learn about the institute, its team, and approach to training.
- [Contact us](https://connectingdotserp.com/contactus): Contact information and office locations in Pune, Mumbai, and Raipur.
- [Placements](https://connectingdotserp.com/placements): Placement support and career-related information.
- [Blogs](https://connectingdotserp.com/blogs): Articles and learning resources.
- [Course links](https://connectingdotserp.com/all-course-links): Directory of course pages.
- [Site directory](https://connectingdotserp.com/sitemap): Browse the public page directory.

## Training areas

- SAP training, including SAP FICO, S/4HANA, ABAP, MM, SD, SuccessFactors, and other SAP specializations.
- Information technology and software training, including programming, cloud, DevOps, full-stack development, and AI-related programs.
- Data and analytics training, including data science, data analytics, Power BI, and Tableau.
- Human resources training, including core HR, HR analytics, payroll, and HR management.
